title: [finding] `@object-ui/i18n` never loads the built-in Chinese catalogue for a stored `zh-CN` locale — the lazy loaders are keyed by base code `zh` with no region fallback, so after a reload all Console chrome reverts to English
body:
Filing gate: **① a reproducible product defect with a named landing site** — `packages/i18n/src/locales/registry.ts` (`isBuiltInLanguage` / `loadBuiltInLocale`) and its call sites in `packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx`. `reach:` the Console a stock showcase serves (`supportedLocales: ['en','zh-CN']`; the language menu offers only "中文（中国）"), reproduced in a browser on fresh boots (runner + independent verifier). Reader: triage first touch, then the lane owning `@object-ui/i18n`. Dedupe: semantic search "zh-CN locale built-in catalogue not loaded after reload console chrome English loadBuiltInLocale" (open + closed) → 17 hits, none this defect — the designer-English family (e.g. #10862, #10969, #10748) is about missing catalogue ROWS; this is the catalogue never being loaded at all.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21056 · approvals.account-app-entry · acceptance[6]

## What happens

With the Console locale set to 中文（中国） (`zh-CN`), a full page load renders all built-in chrome in English (PREVIEW, Search…, Refresh, the approvals inbox h1 "Approvals Inbox", tabs "My Pending / Submitted by me / All", badge "Pending") while server-translated labels (e.g. the nav entry 待我审批) stay Chinese — a mixed-language UI. Only `i18n-locale-en-*.js` is fetched. Picking 中文（中国） from the menu also leaves the chrome English unless the `zh` catalogue happens to be loaded already.

## Reproduction

1. Showcase on framework `objectstack-ai/objectstack@ef1ed17f` with the Console at pin `db11afd4967c`: `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`.
2. Sign in, avatar → Preferences → Language → 中文（中国） (`PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user/<id> {"locale":"zh-CN"}`; `localStorage['objectui-locale']="zh-CN"`; `<html lang="zh-CN">`).
3. Full page load of `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/approvals/inbox`.
   - Expected: h1 审批中心, tabs 待我审批 / 我发起的 / 全部, badge 待审批.
   - Actual: English chrome as above; `performance.getEntriesByType('resource')` lists only `i18n-locale-en-*.js`.
4. Contrast: on a device with no stored `objectui-locale`, a fresh sign-in (server locale `zh-CN`) fetches `i18n-locale-zh-*.js` and renders Chinese; the next reload reverts to English.

## Mechanism

- `locales/registry.ts`: `LAZY_LOCALE_LOADERS` is keyed by base code (`zh: () => import('./zh.js')`); `isBuiltInLanguage` and `loadBuiltInLocale` use exact `hasOwnProperty` lookups, so `'zh-CN'` → `false` / `null`.
- `provider.tsx` call sites with no base-code fallback: `preloadBootstrapLocale` → `loadBuiltInLocale(resolveBootstrapLanguage())` (the stored `zh-CN` is accepted as provisional), the mount effect's `if (!isBuiltInLanguage(currentLang)) return;`, and `changeLanguage` → `loadBuiltInLocale(lang)`.
- The exact-then-base fallback exists only in `resolveSeedLanguage` (`seed.split('-')[0]`), which is why only the seed path (fresh sign-in, nothing stored) reaches Chinese.
- Unchanged at objectui HEAD `582edef1c` (source level).

## Landing site and acceptance

- Apply the same exact-then-base normalisation as `resolveSeedLanguage` inside `isBuiltInLanguage` / `loadBuiltInLocale` (or at the three `provider.tsx` call sites), so `zh-CN` loads the `zh` catalogue.
- Pin: a unit test that `loadBuiltInLocale('zh-CN')` resolves the `zh` catalogue and that a provider bootstrapped with a stored `zh-CN` renders a built-in key in Chinese.
- Done when step 3 renders Chinese chrome after a full reload and `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[6] re-runs green.
